title: GridGreen
description: 2nd Place, Cloud Track at DataHacks 2026. A carbon-aware ML copilot that reads training scripts, estimates compute and CO₂ cost from published scaling laws, and suggests greener models via RAG. Built on Claude via MCP, Databricks DLT, Snowflake, and SageMaker.

title: Socially-Aware Recommendation System
description: Top-N ranking on Epinions (664K+ reviews, 49K users) at 99.99% sparsity using social trust-graph features. Beat a published IJCAI 2017 baseline by 6% AUC; deployed with FastAPI and Docker on Hugging Face Spaces.

title: MediDB: Clinical Decision Support
description: Drug safety and recommendation system combining graph queries in Neo4j, vector search over FAERS adverse events in Qdrant, and relational EHR records in PostgreSQL, with ETL from Synthea synthetic data.

title: GameSoul (in progress)
description: Emotion-driven game discovery: LLaMA 3 extracts 9-dimensional emotion vectors from Steam reviews, a Thompson sampling bandit personalizes picks, and Kafka streaming supports continual learning.

title: Deceptive Visualization: Life Expectancy
description: DSC 209R Project 2. Two versions of the same life expectancy data: one chart that exaggerates the gap between rich and poor countries, and an honest one that shows how it has converged.

title: Cloudflare AI Chat with Memory
description: A chat app on Cloudflare Workers AI (Llama 3.3). A Worker orchestrates the UI and model calls, and Durable Objects store each session's conversation history.

title: Autodiff Engine and Transformer
description: A custom automatic differentiation engine written from scratch, without PyTorch autograd, used to train a decoder-only Transformer with causal self-attention and autoregressive decoding.

title: GPU Kernels and Distributed Training
description: A fused Triton kernel for ReLU(AB + C) with shared-memory tiling and tuning, plus distributed Transformer training from scratch with MPI: AllReduce, AllToAll, data and tensor parallelism.

title: LLM Agent for CI/CD Routing (IBM)
description: A production LLM agent that read code diffs, classified cloud environment impact, and routed CI/CD test runs on its own, cutting cloud compute costs by 40%. Won IBM's Star of the Month.

title: Multi-Cloud Provisioning Backend (IBM)
description: A Python backend on IBM Cloud APIs that provisions resources across AWS, Azure, and IBM Cloud.

title: Data Validation Pipeline Rebuild (IBM)
description: Rebuilt a preprocessing pipeline that was silently corrupting downstream ML releases, restructuring the logic end to end and cutting processing time by 90%.

title: Direct Marketing Campaign Analysis
description: Tableau analysis of a Portuguese bank's direct marketing campaign data.

title: Speech Recognition with Wav2Vec2 (Samsung PRISM)
description: Applied Wav2Vec2 to validate phoneme accuracy against ground truth, improving speech recognition by 10%, and built a pipeline that generated a phoneme dataset from 10,000+ contact names.

title: Online Survey System
description: A web application for creating and answering online surveys, built with Java servlets.
